Ethiopia's Renewable Power System: Converting Generation Capacity into Reliable Industrial Growth and Regional Trade

Ethiopia has created one of Africa's largest predominantly renewable power systems. Its next development test is operational: turning generation capacity into dependable electricity for households and industry while expanding regional trade without allowing exports, new plants or headline megawatts to outrun the networks and institutions that make power economically useful.
